output.english_question: Under RBI's UCB responsible lending directions, for a retail borrower taking a non-business loan, can we levy a higher default charge than we would impose on a corporate customer for the same breach?
sub_queries: RBI UCB responsible lending directions default charges retail borrower non-business loan
RBI regulation penal interest charges uniformity across customer categories breach
UCB responsible lending directions disclosure and limits penal charges default
premises: The question compares charges for the same breach between a retail borrower (non-business loan) and a corporate customer.
The bank is considering whether higher default charges are permissible under RBI UCB responsible lending directions.
“Default charge” may include penal interest and/or penal charges.
